name: @aiengineer/knowledge-binding-biotech-graph
description: K06: the Biotech graph binding. Operational K02 records live in the knowledge_verification component of the Biotech application PostgreSQL; exact-use admission enqueues one dispatch per effect in the same transaction; the BKS native executor applies it (graph effect + marker in one Neo4j transaction) and KS verifies the acknowledgment and serves official reads over BKS HTTP. No Neo4j driver.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/testing.ts --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --rootDir src --outDir dist
